notes.title: Update 1.1 - Trophy Room!
notes.content:
[h3]The latest update for Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition has arrived![/h3][h3][b]
🏆 Welcome to the Trophy Room! 🏆[/b][/h3][p]
This update is all about celebrating the moments that matter, the wins you’ve worked hard for, the milestones you’ve reached, and the goals still ahead of you.[/p][p] To mark these moments, we’ve added 25 new [b]in-game[/b] achievements throughout your Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition journey. Each one is designed to challenge your skills and give you something new to strive for. [/p][p]And where better to honour those in-game achievements than in your very own Trophy Room? Every time you complete an achievement, you’ll unlock a trophy to add to your collection. Pick it up, admire it up close, or display it proudly alongside your other hard-earned rewards, a keepsake of your journey.  
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/e1ee011ecb990b618f3fbef13abbae702f9ca6ec.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Achievement List:[/b][/p][list][*][p]First Steps - get to prestige 2 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]On the road to greatness - get to prestige 4 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]World class - get to prestige 6 on Flat Race[/p][/*][*][p]First jumps - get to prestige 2 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Leaping for the stars - get to prestige 4 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Legendary champion - get to prestige 6 on Cross Country[/p][/*][*][p]Having a mare - breed 3 mares[/p][/*][*][p]Silver stallion - breed 3 stallions[/p][/*][*][p]Amateur breeder - breed 10 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Experienced breeder - breed 50 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Master breeder - breed 100 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Horse friends - own 3 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Four's a party - own 4 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Crowded house - own 7 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Full house - own 14 horses[/p][/*][*][p]Eat my dust - win a rival race 4 times[/p][/*][*][p]Big bucks - sell a horse worth more than 30,000[/p][/*][*][p]Multiplayer challenger - complete 1 online race[/p][/*][*][p]Championship racer - win 5 online races[/p][/*][*][p]First foal - own a horse with a grade of 2[/p][/*][*][p]Genetically superior - own a horse with a grade of 4[/p][/*][*][p]Bred to win - own a horse with a grade of 6[/p][/*][*][p]Horse whisperer - discover 15 of your horses' favourites[/p][/*][*][p]Unbreakable bond - reach bond level 5 with 1 horse[/p][/*][*][p]Horse tycoon - have 500,000 gold
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Further Changes and additions.[/b][/h3][p]
In response to your feedback, we’ve made a few changes to the controls and other early aspects of the game.  

An alternative horse racing control scheme using buttons and joysticks has been added alongside the existing motion controls, giving players who struggle with gestures a more responsive and intuitive option, which can be found in the pause menu during races. To support this, a new tutorial has been introduced to help players learn the updated controls.  

We have also adjusted the first horse preferences  to make the opening two races more exciting and enjoyable for players.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]  [/p][p]That's all for this update, folks. We hope you enjoy everything update 1.1 has to offer. To keep up to date with everything Rival Stars, make sure you join our Discord community. Until next time, Happy Riding!
[/p][p]
[b][i]1.1 Change List[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]New Environment: Trophy Room[/p][/*][*][p]New addition - In-game achievements[/p][/*][*][p]New Customisation Set[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now choose between motion controls and a new button-and-joystick control scheme for flat racing. This can be toggled via the pause menu during a race..[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now access a new tutorial to learn how to use the alternative control option.[/p][/*][*][p]We've made minor adjustments to the difficulty of the early races to make the game feel more rewarding right from the start[/p][/*][*][p]Applied a fix to reduce the number of game crashes experienced by players[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes and optimisations[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: VR Controls and FAQ
notes.content:
Need help getting started on the race track? Here's some information about VR controls and gameplay.

[h3]General Questions[/h3]

[b]Where can I buy the game?[/b]

You can purchase Rival Stars Horse Racing here on Steam.

[b]How do I control the horse during a race?[/b]

The game uses motion controls, so place your hands in front of you in line with the horse's head and perform the actions with clear, controlled movements. Below are some detailed instructions with diagrams using the Meta Quest controllers. Different controller types might have slightly different button placements and controls.

[b]Holding reins[/b]

Hold the reins by pressing and holding both grip buttons on the controllers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/2196975ac150ed31e33d422192d927ebfa6daa84.jpg[/img]

[b]Start race[/b]

Press the trigger buttons when the timing bar is in the green part of the sprint bar at the start of the race.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/852ea085f9804b7f88c76c2f9d7f1f3632da8adb.jpg[/img]

[b]Gaining sprint energy[/b]

To gain energy, move the controllers in a smooth up and down motion at the same time. Make sure to hold them straight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/67fa3b03ed0f4ed2f9fa7ae0da0d30c866ba054d.jpg[/img]

[b]Sprinting[/b]

To sprint, move the controllers in a smooth backwards and forwards motion at the same time. Don't whip the controllers up and down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/21488d83fdcfee1be782a73bb81ead4c4dacd423.jpg[/img]

[b]Turning[/b]

To turn your horse, you need to pull the reins back on either side of the horse. Pull back on the left controller to turn your horse left. Pull back on the right controller to turn your horse right. Only pull one side at a time and keep the other controller still. Note: Horses will not turn if there is another horse or an object blocking them, even if it is not in your field of view. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/c434e6448b0048a0307dec1827b181786e3ab526.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/b9101448e6e1ca1b84b772b4c644caf2b2755394.jpg[/img]

This game mimics the movement of the horse's gallop. Remember to keep up the rhythm when sprinting and gaining energy.

[h3]Gameplay Questions[/h3]

[b]How do I customize my horse?[/b]

Get near a horse until you see the prompt to open the Horse Menu. At the menu, go to the horse's information section, and you will find the customize button at the bottom. Select any peace of tack and select them press equip. 

Now you can show your style on the race track.

 
[b]How do I claim rewards/progress through the story?[/b]

After completing the goal, a pop-up will appear with a prompt to open the Goals screen. On this screen, you can claim your completed goals and progress through the story using the Claim button.

If you miss the popup while on the screen, you can also open the Horse Menu, navigate to the Goals screen, and claim it whenever you desire.


[b]How do I improve my horses?[/b]

You can improve your horse through completing races, even if you don't come first. To do so, go into the Race and Ride screen through the Horse Menu and race on Flat Racing or Cross Country. At the end of each mode, you will receive training points for the relevant Stats of your horse. Repeat this, and you will reach the maximum potential of your horse in no time; you can always race on easier races to train your horse and give yourself an advantage for future challenging races. 


[b]What is the benefit of bonding?[/b]

Bonding is a system that lets the player feel more in touch with their horses and also rewards players with extra Stat Points. Even though these extra points are not limited by the maximum stat potential of the horse, bonding points are limited and will be distributed depending on the horse's strengths.


[b]What is the purpose of the horse's preferences?[/b]

The preference system lets you understand your horse better. By using items that your horse prefers, the bonding process will be more effective and efficient.


[b]Why aren't the controls responding?[/b]

Try using the recenter function of your headset. For Steam VR or the Valve Index, press the right joystick for a couple of seconds to recenter.


We'll continue to adjust and improve controls as the game moves forward.

Now head out there and race!

notes.title: Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition - Looking Forward
notes.content:
We wanted to share a quick update on where things are at with Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition.

We know the game isn’t performing quite where we want it to be yet, and we’ve heard your feedback loud and clear. Because of that, we’re shifting our focus for now to gameplay improvements rather than pushing ahead with new features right away.

Don’t worry — we still have exciting new features planned! They’re definitely on the way, but we want to make sure the core experience is stronger first before adding more to the game.

Based on what we’ve seen from player feedback and our own data, there are a few major areas we’re focusing on:

[list]
[*] Difficulty using the sprinting and stamina recharge gestures
[*] Crashes that are impacting gameplay
[/list]

Making improvements here is our top priority as we plan out the next steps for the game.

Thank you so much for sticking with us. Your support, feedback, and patience mean the world to the team. We’re committed to making Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition the best it can be, and we’re excited for everything that’s still ahead!

notes.title: Launch Day - Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

First of all, we want to thank you for your support following the launch of Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition. We are so excited to finally be able to share the game with you.

We’re aware of a few issues currently affecting gameplay, and we want to be transparent about what we know so far. Our team is actively investigating these and working on fixes and improvements where we can.

You’ll find an overview of the current known issues below. We’ll continue to keep you updated as we learn more, so keep an eye on the News tab and future patch notes for the latest info.

[b]
🛠️ Steam VR - Known Issues[/b]
The following issues on Steam have already been identified and are being investigated:

[b]Loss of focus:[/b]
[list]
[*] If another window (like SteamVR or a system popup) takes focus away from the game, players may lose the ability to interact/ their in-game hands may disappear.
[*] Suggested Action: Refocus the game window either by clicking it in Desktop mode or using the Alt+Tab keys. 
[/list]
[b]Audio issues at the Ranch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players may experience a loss of audio at the ranch after bonding with their horses.
[*] Suggested Action: Relaunch the game.
[/list]
[b]Floating objects in Free Roam and Cross Country:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some objects in Free Roam and Cross Country, such as trees, may appear to be floating slightly above the ground.
[*] Suggested Action: Visual Issue - No suggested action currently available.
[/list]
[b]Pasture animation glitches:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players may notice unintended horse behaviours when their animations are interrupted while in the Pasture.
[*] Suggested Action: Visual Issue - No suggested action currently available.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Blog: The Countdown Begins
notes.content:
Mark your calendars—April 17th is almost here! Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition is just days away from launch. In just four days, you’ll be able to step into the jockey silks, feel the rush of the track, and race like never before.

But before we hit the starting gate, let’s talk about what’s coming in the lead-up to launch—including our launch roadmap!

[h2]What to Expect on Launch Day[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/fc4277512b09d8979c8442058bf3506c74de8eb2.png[/img]

When the gates open on April 17th, Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition will be available on Meta and Steam VR. Whether you’re racing for glory or just taking in the view, here’s what’s waiting for you at launch:

[list]
[*] Flat Racing – Experience the thrill of the track from the jockey’s perspective.
[*] Cross Country – Feel the rush of the ride as you navigate rugged terrain and daring obstacles.
[*] Free Roam - The world is yours to explore
[*] Bonding – Feed, groom, and interact with your horse to grow closer and become champions
[*] Story - Stuck in the corporate world, you make a big change with TJ’s help—only to find yourself in the middle of a surprising rivalry. 
[/list]

[h2]The Road Ahead[/h2]

Launch day is just the beginning! We’ve got a roadmap packed with updates to keep your VR racing experience fresh.

[h3]First Patch [/h3]

Our first update will focus on bringing the world to life and improving the racing experience:
Horse Animation – Improved animations make your horses feel more lifelike, with smoother, more natural movements.

[list]
[*] New Celebrations – Post-race celebrations are bigger and better, making victories feel even more rewarding.
[*] Smoother Locomotion – Movement has been fine-tuned for a more seamless and realistic experience. [/list]
[h3]Coming Soon[/h3]

We’re introducing new ways to build your racing legacy:
[list]
[*] Trophy Room – You’re a champion! Showcase your achievements in style.
[*] Horse Market – Buy and sell horses to create your dream stable.
[/list]
[h3]Beyond[/h3]

We have even more in store, including:
[list]
[*] New Locations – More tracks to test your skills.
[*] New Interactions – Make the environment feel more life-like wth more ways to engage with the ranch and stables.
[/list]

[h2]Community Engagement – Share Your Ride![/h2]

Four days to go—who’s ready? As we gear up for launch, don’t forget to follow us on [[url=https://link.pikpok.com/m/Rival-Stars-Socials]socials[/url]] and join our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/JC99MCGztx]Discord [/url]to stay in the loop. Whether you’re swapping tips, sharing your favourite moments, or just hanging out, the Rival Stars Horse Racing Community is the place to be. 

The track is calling, and your VR racing journey is about to begin!

notes.title: Developer Blog: Designing for VR
notes.content:
Creating a realistic horse racing experience in VR comes with its own unique set of hurdles, and building Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition has been both challenging and rewarding. Our aim was to fully immerse players in the world of horse racing while ensuring a smooth, comfortable, and authentic experience.

[h2]Dealing with Motion Sickness in VR[/h2]

Motion sickness is a common issue in VR, so we worked to minimise it by positioning the player’s view right at the rider’s perspective, with the horse’s head always in sight. This helps give players a steady focal point, reducing the chances of feeling disoriented. We also added a fixed UI and some subtle wind effects to guide players through the track, enhancing the sense of speed without overwhelming the senses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001841/8e5b09b649f8f3bf56b6c3054943f9777f4995a3.png[/img]

[h2]Bringing Cross Country to Life[/h2]

Cross Country mode posed its own challenges with its jumps and winding paths. To help players stay focused on the course, we added a vignette effect that slightly darkens the edges of the screen, keeping attention on the path ahead. We’ve also spent a lot of time fine-tuning the horse’s turning mechanics to ensure the movements feel smooth and natural.

[h2]Striking a Balance with Controls[/h2]

Controls are a key part of any VR game, especially for something as intricate as horse riding. We tested various methods, including joystick controls and automatic galloping. After gathering player feedback, we landed on a control scheme that feels intuitive and accessible, even for players who may not be familiar with horse riding, while still keeping a realistic feel.

Throughout the process, we focused on making every interaction feel seamless and enjoyable, whether it’s the thrill of a close race finish, the satisfaction of a well-timed jump, or simply spending time in the stable.

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
Developing Rival Stars Horse Racing: VR Edition has been a creative journey full of problem-solving and fun. The game is set to launch in early 2025, and you can wishlist it now!

We can’t wait for you to experience the world of horse racing in VR, In the meantime feel free to check our latest Dev Vlog.— see you at the starting line!

[previewyoutube=Q3qn22fGy-o;full][/previewyoutube]
